entity.name: HR Hub
entity.description:
HR Hub is a next-generation, cloud-native HR platform designed to streamline every stage of the employee lifecycle—from onboarding through performance management and offboarding—while giving HR teams the agility and insights they need to scale.

Built on Microsoft Azure and secured by Auth0, HR Hub supports true multi-tenant deployments so you can manage multiple subsidiaries or clients from a single, unified dashboard. Our no-code automation engine leverages Azure Logic Apps to:

Automatically provision Auth0 user accounts and send welcome kits

Route time-off requests through Teams or Slack for one-click approvals

Trigger exit questionnaires, equipment-return tasks and deprovisioning workflows on employee termination

Deliver daily birthday and anniversary announcements via Teams, Slack or email

Document management, configurable approval chains and granular role-based access ensure full auditability and compliance, while our open REST API lets you connect HR Hub to any third-party system (ERP, payroll, recruiting platforms).

Whether you’re a fast-growing startup or a global enterprise, HR Hub helps you eliminate manual processes, reduce risk and deliver an exceptional employee experience—all from one modern, extensible platform.
